issue.body:
Jira Link: [DB-8249](https://yugabyte.atlassian.net/browse/DB-8249)
### Description

After fixing https://github.com/yugabyte/yugabyte-db/issues/11516 we note that there may still be failures when running the jepsen with `--TEST_inject_sleep_before_applying_intents_ms=50`

Seems to happen in 5% of the runs.

(This hasn't yet been seen in runs without `--TEST_inject_sleep_before_applying_intents_ms=50`, but given the asynchronous nature of threads and processes, the possibility that it occurs cannot be ruled out)

```
{:type :ok, :f :txn, :value [[:append 36 9]], :time 284574780603, :process 381, :op-timing ["2022-04-12_12:07:00.194" "2022-04-12_12:07:00.428"], :index 13284}
{:type :ok, :f :txn, :value [[:append 36 8]], :time 284473121654, :process 578, :op-timing ["2022-04-12_12:07:00.194" "2022-04-12_12:07:00.326"], :index 13268}
```
got read both values, but read 8 is the faulty one
```
{:type :ok, :f :txn, :value [[:r 36 [8]] [:append 25 52] [:r 36 [8]]], :time 284536797654, :process 727, :op-timing ["2022-04-12_12:07:00.283" "2022-04-12_12:07:00.390"], :index 13280}

{:type :ok, :f :txn, :value [[:r 36 [9 34]] [:r 36 [9 34]]], :time 284885926585, :process 511, :op-timing ["2022-04-12_12:07:00.713" "2022-04-12_12:07:00.739"], :index 13338}
```
